title: About this site
p1: Every piece was drawn live inside VectorCraft over its MCP server — the driving scripts live in @work/@ in the "repo":https://github.com/drawmeanelephant/f-artcraft. Nothing is raster-edited: the @.vectorcraft@ natives are the source of truth, the SVGs are the public viewable form, and the PNGs shown here are the @2x proof renders (lettering is Virelai Sans, so the proofs are the faithful display).
p2: Revisions are immutable: @<slug>-V<V>R<RR>@. V is the interpretation, R the revision inside it — a refinement bumps R, a redesign bumps V. Previous revision files are read-only; a bad revision is fixed by the next one, never edited in place.
p3: The site is dogfooded: @docs/gen_data.py@ scans the repo, the @docs/src/*.knap@ templates plus the generated JSON render through "dogbed":https://github.com/drawmeanelephant/dogbed (k4o → Textile → oliver → HTML) via @docs/build.sh@, and GitHub Actions deploys @docs/site/@ to GitHub Pages. The HTML is generated and committed — a CI job fails if it goes stale.
